info.title: sell-shells API
info.description: Public catalog GET requests for shells, shell types, and images allow anonymous browsing. Stock data and inventory writes require admin or superadmin authentication; role management requires superadmin. Guest commerce uses a random X-Shop-Token capability for browser sessions; customers do not sign in. PayPal checkout is configured through server-only environment variables.
